items.title: ‘Desperate’ to Travel, but Rising Costs Point to ‘Uneven’ Summer
items.summary: Outlooks and surveys project a busy summer for the travel industry, but climbing fuel prices likely mean bookings will be driven by higher-earning households.

items.title: Extreme Day Trips: Climate Costs and a Debate the Travel Industry Can’t Avoid
items.summary: The extreme daytripping debate has raised fresh concerns about the climate impacts of an industry that largely says it is committed to responsible tourism and reducing emissions.

items.title: Airbnb and Uber Want to Own More of Your Trip: History Says It Will Be Tough
items.summary: Both Airbnb and Uber have massive audiences. At first glance, expanding their travel offerings looks like an opportunity there for the taking. They will both need to prove it.

items.title: H World’s Earnings Call: Premium Shift and Southeast Asia Expansion
items.summary: H World is betting that China’s real estate slump and Southeast Asia’s travel boom can fuel its next phase of growth.

items.title: Travel Brands Think They Have a Gen Z Problem. Most Have Two.
items.summary: Reaching Gen Z is a distribution problem, resonating with them is a product problem. Few travel brands have figured out which one they actually have. Those that haven't are already losing ground — they just can't see it in the numbers yet.

items.title: America’s Travel Problem Is Getting Worse
items.summary: International travel to the United States dropped another 14%, raising new questions about America’s image abroad just weeks before the World Cup begins.

items.title: This CEO Says There’s ‘No Moat’ in Hospitality: Peregrine’s Playbook
items.summary: Peregrine Hospitality's CEO admits hotels have no competitive moat. His fix is operational discipline. The question is whether that'll be enough to deliver results.

items.title: China to Order 200 Boeing Planes, First Order in Nearly a Decade
items.summary: The order is major win for Boeing, which has been shut out of the Chinese market for nearly decade due to trade tensions between the U.S. and China.
